name: P03-accept-meaning-and-microphone
why: Marcia's rulings 2026-09-16, after the pilot session on Ruth 1:15–18 took seven tellings of Naomi's one-verse line (the voice sent the team back for 'vai atrás da tua cunhada' vs 'vá você também embora', for 'já foi' vs 'está indo', and re-explained the same nuance three times) and the team never touched the microphone because the voice asked, in the same breath, 'me contem em português'. Turn 1: the team says it has the part — heard only inside the whole passage, which is not its opening (Marcia's word, 2026-09-23 evening) — so the Guide opens it and ends with her fixed closing, no fenced block (part_opening_closing, ruling 2026-09-23). Turn 2: the team says 'Entendemos. Vamos pro ensaio.' — the Guide invites the rehearsal with the red-microphone sentence ALONE (no oral telling-back in the same turn). Turn 3: the team tells Naomi's line back in other words that carry the whole meaning (sister-in-law, gone back to her people and her gods, go too) — the Guide must ACCEPT it and move on; a nuance ('atrás da tua cunhada') may be named once, never as a send-back. Turn 4: the team adds a fact the map does not give (Naomi pointing with her hand, and 'because she was tired') — the Guide must name the addition. Turn 5: the faithful telling again — accepted. Ruling 2026-09-21 (the fenced rehearsal block): the invitation at turn 2 and the send-back at turn 4 must end with 'Agora vou dizer tudo o que deve entrar no ensaio de vocês.' … only the story … 'Agora podem ensaiar.' and the microphone — no commentary inside the fence. Marcia's ruling (a) of 2026-09-24 (prompts/guide_system_prompt.md, 'Opening a part', rule 2: 'o passo a passo' is the fence): turn 6 — after scene 1's telling was accepted, the team asks to open scene 2 (take_up_closing: after a whole telling the voice may already have opened it on its own, and the full closing ends with the tail too); turn 7 — 'Fale essa parte pra nós, o passo a passo da fala de Rute pra Noemi.', the shape of pilot P08 (24 Sept: 'o passo a passo … da fala de Noemi com Rute', after a part opening; the voice answered as a retelling asked for to understand, 'Primeiro … Sétimo …' and the closing's last two sentences, and the team went to the red microphone without ever hearing the fence), here on a speech part — Ruth's vow, whose map lists its bindings one by one ('First binding? … Sixth binding?'). The answer is the fenced block and the red-microphone sentence, the vow told step by step in plain sentences, in the story's order, with no number or label on any step (fenced_rehearsal also fails a step label inside the fence and the closing's last two sentences after it — a builder's call on 'passo a passo, se pedirem assim').

turns.team: Entendemos a primeira parte: Noemi fala com Rute depois que Orfa voltou. Vamos ensaiar essa parte na nossa língua.
Contando de volta: Noemi disse pra Rute: a sua cunhada foi embora para o povo dela e para os deuses dela. Vá você também embora.
A gente contou de novo assim: Noemi apontou com a mão pra estrada, porque estava cansada de insistir, e disse: a sua cunhada voltou pro povo dela e pros deuses dela; volta você também, atrás dela.

Entendi, a história não conta que ela apontou nem por quê. Então de novo, só com o que a história conta: Noemi disse pra Rute: a sua cunhada voltou pro povo dela e pros deuses dela. Volta você também, atrás da sua cunhada.
Pode abrir a segunda parte pra gente.
Fale essa parte pra nós, o passo a passo da fala de Rute pra Noemi.
